【ARTIFICIAL PLANTS & GREENERY】 The wire vine inside each eucalyptus garland is highly flexible 💪, allowing you to fix the greenery garland into any shape or position for your wedding or home decor needs!

【NO TOXIC CHEMICAL SMELLS like others】 Safely use our artificial Eucalyptus Garland Greenery Indoors and Outdoors around Wedding Guests, Kids, Family & Pets without the worry of any nasty allergies! Made from top quality, non-harmful, waterproof and UV resilient materials, show off your decorating prowess with complete peace of mind, and without the fear of any severe allergic reactions! 🤧

【GREENERY GARLAND READY TO USE】 NO WASHING required and NO STRANGE WHITE POWDERS that flake off when you unbox the frosted eucalyptus garland vines 🙏 Extremely low maintenance and long-lasting greenery garland. Simply wipe clean if required.
